meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在容器中执行 Bash 命令时，命令会自动经过 rtk 代理，压缩常见开发命令（如 git、cargo、pytest 等）的输出，节省 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当您让 Claude 运行 Bash 命令（如 git status、pytest）时，PreToolUse 钩子会自动将命令交给 rtk 处理。

say.text: 运行 git status 查看仓库状态
say.note: 此命令会经 rtk 代理，压缩输出节省 token。

say.text: 执行 pytest 运行测试
say.note: 测试命令会由 rtk 处理后执行。

say.text: 运行 docker ps 列出容器
say.note: docker 命令经 rtk 代理，节省 token。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Claude executes Bash commands in the container, the commands are automatically routed through rtk, which compresses output of common dev commands (e.g., git, cargo, pytest, etc.) to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude runs a Bash command (e.g., git status, pytest) in the configured container; the PreToolUse hook intercepts the call and routes it to rtk.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the repo state.
say_en.note: The command goes through rtk to save tokens.

say_en.text: Run docker ps to list containers.
say_en.note: Docker command is proxied by rtk.
